prerequisite: NI2-006 real frozen-source two-registered-worker gate and independent Principal verification. Current one-worker/distribution component proofs do not satisfy it.

existing_contract.profile: partitioned-fixed-v1 finite SOURCE→OPERATOR P2; named logical operators, four physical TaskRuns and four producer StreamPartition rows.
existing_contract.input_shape: One scalar input_stream_id and one StreamConsumer per physical TaskRun; no native fan-in or join.
existing_contract.authority: Current immutable child scope binds graph/assignment/subtask/grant/physical epoch and own input/output; upcoming persisted-worker-placement successor must be accepted before this review becomes implementation handoff.
existing_contract.store: Existing StreamPartition/Record/Consumer/Completion remain the data plane. StreamSubmission unique upstream and consumer/TaskRun coupling are concrete fan-out/multi-input constraints.

stories: As a developer, I want explicit named ports and branch exchanges without creating a TaskRun per document.
As a user, I want replacing branch B to leave branch C accepted records and cursor unchanged.
As a system, I want all bounded route references, output/state/receipt and input completion to commit atomically under one sealed routing revision.

changes_needed: Versioned logical port/edge manifest with stable operator/output/input/subscriber identities; acyclic validation and typed port compatibility before task starts.
Explicit profile/version boundary preserving the accepted bounded-linear-v1 and partitioned-fixed-v1 interpretation.
Reject fan-in/multiple physical inputs until NI2-021 supplies a mailbox and shared-state apply order; a DAG with branches is not a correlated join.
architect_decisions: Portable port type/schema identity and whether to start with one named output per ordinary Task.
Duplicate subscriber identity and explicit edge identity independent of physical TaskRun attempts.
Finite-prefix/tail dependency and terminal aggregate behavior when one branch fails.

changes_needed: Persist forward/rebalance/broadcast/keyed route targets at producer terminal append. Readers consume persisted targets; a retry never reroutes using replacement-local state.
Use existing StreamPartition for ordered edge partitions and existing immutable producer envelopes; route references/pins are metadata, not a second independent record store.
Extend both source append and operator YIELD terminal transactions. Existing epoch-1 state-only RETURN must retain its current decoding.
Freeze canonical key codec/hash/group/routing versions and assignment. Do not use Python hash() or a process-local round-robin counter.
Admit a bounded terminal-write budget for the complete route set. One full target must refuse the whole turn without partial fan-out/cursor/state advancement.
architect_decisions: Concrete route-reference representation and composite foreign keys to original immutable record/turn identities.
Stable route digest lookup after lost ACK, attempt change and later assignment transfer.
Lock order over Flow authority, graph/subtask fence, TaskRun, sorted producer/edge partitions and subscriber state.
Independent subscriber retention/pins and branch failure policy; online GC remains NI2-040+ work.

changes_needed: Paired client/server DTOs for ports, edges, exchanges and immutable routing manifests, without importing server modules into the client.
Update graph authoring descriptors and packaged worker bootstrap while preserving ordinary Task definitions and one TaskRun per physical subtask.
Keep child credentials restricted to own granted resources. Producer route fan-out is server-derived from sealed scope; the child cannot nominate arbitrary target streams.
Preserve persisted worker placement, one Flow lease and ordinary task/tag lease ownership. The complete live branch region must fit or be safely queued before sources start.
architect_decisions: Exact public SDK spelling; this review deliberately defines no speculative new SDK method or profile literal.
Whether existing scalar child input context can remain for single-input fan-out and how an edge/subscriber lineage key is exposed to user code.
Bounded graph/subtask/worker/route-limit projection without capabilities or sibling parameters in child bootstrap.

changes_needed: Exact route-set retries around accepted/lost ACK and branch-only process replacement.
Persisted branch subscriber cursors; completing B must not acknowledge C, even when they share one producer envelope.
Keep durable logical/input lineage independent of TaskRun attempt and later assignment identity.
architect_decisions: Failure cuts before/after producer commit and before/after consumer completion on each branch.
Retention behavior of a failed mandatory branch while another branch is healthy; no invented atomic guarantee across external sinks.

changes_needed: Real SDK/HTTP/PostgreSQL/process branched gate on a frozen commit/source map, independently executed by Principal.
Different exchange and partition counts, real branch failure, exact route digests, stable healthy process identities and no cross-branch ACK.
500/5000 records with fixed operator/subtask/partition execution-metadata counts, bounded admitted routing overhead and no TaskRun per document.
architect_decisions: Fixed graph oracle and exact target cardinalities before implementation.
Scope of distinct workers versus cross-host authority: two workers on one host do not establish ADR-0047 verified-stop/cross-host acceptance.

proposed_acceptance_oracles: As a system, I can reject a cycle, incompatible port, duplicate subscriber, unsupported fan-in/profile or incompatible forward parallelism before user code and unsafe resource allocation.
As a user, I got branch B replacement at its first incomplete coordinate while branch C retained the same accepted prefix and healthy process identity.
As a system, I got an identical route set/digest after an accepted append ACK was lost; output references and subscriber cursors have no duplicate or omission.
As a system, I can refuse one turn when any required route target lacks capacity, observing no partial producer/output/state/receipt/cursor commit.
As a developer, I can inspect named original producer/edge/partition/sequence lineage and the documented absence of implicit cross-partition total order.
As a developer, I got client wheel/source distributions whose graph DTOs and scoped worker/child transports import without server-only modules.
deferred_scope: Multi-input state ownership/apply_ordinal and correlated join (NI2-020+).
Explicit tagged NO_OUTPUT/cardinality0..1; preserve old state-only RETURN.
Continuous sources/timers, online retention, cross-host stop authority and rescale under their own ADR gates.
review_limits: Read-only contract impact analysis; no source/runtime/server changes, speculative wire implementation, task acceptance or readiness claim.
